results.title: Lost in Paradise
results.overview: When the founder of a high-end fashion company gets marooned on a "deserted" island with a chef, romance blossoms as they work together to survive.

results.title: Perto do Sol é Mais Claro
results.original_title: Perto do Sol é Mais Claro
results.overview: A touching portrait of Regi, an 85-year-old engineer from Rio de Janeiro, as he deals with the recent loss of his wife. The narrative guides us through his solitary routine, showing the support of his children and his determination to move forward by writing a book and falling in love with a talented actress. The film celebrates life, resilience, and the power of love amid the complexities of aging.

results.title: Khanom valede
results.overview: The story of two brothers who are struggling financially when they suddenly receive an inheritance.

results.title: The Demon Among Us
results.overview: "The Demon Among Us" is inspired by the 1980s film "The Other Hell." The production features special effects by David Bracci and music by Pino Donaggio.

results.title: Kupeluk Kamu Selamanya
results.overview: Naya, a tough mother who lives her life with one main goal, ensuring that her son, Aksa, has a future far better than anything she has ever experienced.

results.title: Pete Holmes: Silly Silly Fun Boy
results.original_title: Pete Holmes: Silly Silly Fun Boy
results.overview: Comedian Pete Holmes delivers fresh takes on parenting, marriage and more.

results.title: CVNT
results.overview: Marni is doing her best: she’s sober, she’s scrappy, and she would do anything for her baby daughter Mila. So when a surprise daycare bill hits and every door slams shut, she finds her solution in the most unexpected Craigslist ad she’s ever seen. Armed with a frozen milk stash, a ride-or-die best friend, and the street smarts she picked up in a past life, Marni pulls off a hustle that’s equal parts absurd, resourceful, and deeply human.

results.title: The Other Mahmoud
results.overview: It follows two contradictory young men with the same name, which puts them in unexpected, strange and funny situations at the same time.

results.title: JĀTI
results.overview: When deeply rooted biases and discrimination tests a couple's love, their relationship faces the reaching effects of casteism beyond India.

results.title: Empire of Lies
results.overview: When a mysterious young woman comes to interview a paranoid man living in rural isolation, he is forced to confront his part in his daughter's murder.

results.title: Only Rebels Win
results.overview: Suzanne and Osmane meet in crisis-ridden Beirut. Osmane is a young Sudanese man without papers, searching for a better future; Suzanne is a widow with Palestinian roots more than twice his age. Against all odds, they fall in love.

results.title: Clear conscience
results.overview: An extremely honest forest ranger fights for the trust to the very end.

results.title: The God of Love
results.overview: Love Divine is a choral journey into romantic relationships, exploring the emotional destinies of interconnected lives. With an ironic, light tone tinged with bitterness, it portrays a humanity caught in the chaos of love. Each character is a knot in an intricate weave shaped by the capricious God of Love, while Ovid, the eternal poet, guides us from ancient Rome into the present.

results.title: Lost Treasure
results.overview: Two brothers, Steve and Toby, must confront buried emotions whilst grieving the recent loss of their mum. To do so, they must first get over the stench of microwaved fish and avoided silences; to reconnect, not as boys, but adult men. And remember the true meaning of family.

results.title: Our Child
results.overview: A young woman from a poor village in China, Xia Jia, arrives in Hong Kong to be a surrogate mother for a wealthy Chinese couple, living with them so they can supervise her pregnancy. It is an isolating experience, made harder by the harsh treatment of the wife towards Xia Jia, driven by bitterness and jealousy.

results.title: METAMETA - The World Without Us
results.overview: A journey through Lars HUG's creative mind and musical universe with the man himself as tour guide, and with brand new songs on the soundtrack.

results.title: Šipkaři
results.overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.
